items.headline: <US Stock Weekly Theme> Energy Storage Systems - TSLA, ENPH, RUN
items.snippet: Mizuho Securities recently upgraded Albemarle's rating, primarily based on upward revisions to lithium demand forecasts driven by stationary energy storage; Benchmark also raised the 2026 global lithium carbonate equivalent demand by 12% to 2.1 million tons.

items.headline: [US Featured Stock] Albemarle strong following Mizuho upgrade
items.snippet: Mizuho raised its investment rating for Albemarle from 'Neutral' to 'Outperform.' It maintained a price target of $130. Mizuho raised Albemarle's adjusted EBITDA estimates to $3.2 billion next year and $2.9 billion in 2028.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral with an unchanged $130 price target. Strong BESS demand has tipped the market balance into favorable territory.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating. The price of lithium is up about 67% year over year, still well below all-time highs; supply and demand trends appear poised to improve into 2027.
